review:
Platinum Lightning Deluxe is the 2018 re-release of BGaming's Greek mythology slot, with upgraded visuals and effects on the same 5-reel, 25-line setup. The wild pays on its own and substitutes for other symbols, and three, four or five wilds multiply a win by 7x, 77x or 777x.

Two bonus symbols on the first and last reels trigger the Sticky Reel bonus with 10 free spins, in which reels 1 and 5 lock as wilds and only the middle reels spin. An optional gamble follows any base-game win. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with an 8,888x maximum and a 96.29% RTP. Free spins land about once every 112 spins.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 112 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
